text:
lina: Heads-up — onboarding customer's sampleapp hit repeated failures when calling embeddings + rerank. Error is 'vector length mismatch' and we saw duplicate batch sends.

samir: Can you paste the logs? curl/response snippets help.

lina: Logs:
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_***
Body: {"model":"open-embed-1","input":["..."],"batching":true}
Response 400 {"error":"vector_length=1536 but model expects=1024","code":"INVALID_INPUT"}
```
Also later we see same payload replayed within 2s and a second 500 from rerank.

mike: This smells like the old batching helper in sampleapp that pads inconsistently. repro steps:
1) use sampleapp v0.2 -> it builds batches by concatenating different sources
2) helper doesn't normalize `pad_to` or reject mixed dims

Snippet from sampleapp:
```js
const batches = batchInputs(inputs, {autoPad: true});
await Promise.all(batches.map(b => api.embeddings.create({model, input: b}))); // no idempotency
```
If inputs had precomputed 1536-dim vectors mixed with 1024, we end up sending wrong shapes.

anya: Heads-up on SDK parity — Node SDK v0.9 returns embeddings as `vectors` while Python v0.9 returns `embeddings`. Our sampleapp assumes `embeddings`. That mismatch can make the helper read the wrong field and treat `undefined` as empty array => length mismatch.

dev-bot: deploy-hook: sampleapp-prod rollback to v0.2 requested by ops at 19:12 UTC

samir: Proposed fixes:
- Validate vector dim server-side and return a clear error code like "INVALID_VECTOR_DIM" (and include expected/current dims).
- Change batching helper to normalize lengths and fail early for mixed dims.
- Add idempotency key per batch so retries don't double-send.

mike: I'll PR a change to the helper. Quick patch:
```js
function sendBatch(batch){
 const idempotencyKey = batch.map(i=>i.id).join(':')+':v1';
 return api.embeddings.create({model, input: batch.data}, {idempotencyKey});
}
```

lina: Also add E2E test in sampleapp that mixes legacy precomputed vectors with new ones. And update onboarding guide to call `validate_vectors()` before sending.

anya: I'll update Node SDK docs and bump version. Also will add compatibility layer returning both `embeddings` and `vectors` fields for one release.

mike: PR #412 raised. please review @samir @lina

samir: Will review. Also add an observability metric for 'batch_dim_mismatch' so we can alert.

lina: thanks — tagging this for next week's release notes. :thumbsup:
